title: OwnCondition closure can promote unrelated ordinary self-upload into task read authority

flow.effect: Exact own condition Scope passes; closure always validates with EvidenceAccess::OwnCondition(conditionId).
Self-uploaded attachment bypasses task binding regardless of ordinary/purpose session or a different child.
The accepted active same-project link is persisted as authenticated closure evidence with a valid hash.
Later exact read joins newly written closure evidence to actor condition and accepts it as frozen task authority.

requiredFix: For OwnConditionOnly, accept only correctly verified existing task refs or an exact matching actual completed purpose session for this parent/child/project/actor and file/link identity. uploaded_by alone grants no purpose. Reuse one sealed same-outer-TX verification boundary; avoid any own-condition fallback that can match another child. FullProject authority, if intentionally supported for evidence selection, must be separately proven, not inferred from uploader.
requiredActualAcceptance: ordinary purpose0 old self-upload, not task-frozen: close rejected and no closure/ref/CAS aggregate business effect survives
self-upload for another condition same project: close rejected for requested child
matching true completed condition-purpose file: close succeeds and exact read succeeds
already frozen original own-task evidence, including another uploader: allowed with current classification/identity guards
expired or noncompleted session, wrong creator, parent/project mismatch, changed file/link/checksum/version: rejected
necessary evidence/closure/audit/auth write fault: rollback and same-body retry, not merely probe
